tools.name: shop_products
tools.description: FIRST tool for shopping, shoes, product comparisons and recommendations on https://sitemcp.dev/. Filters the public store catalog by actual variant availability, exact size and exclusive price ceiling, then reads shortlisted product details concurrently. tools.name: research_pages
tools.description: Best tool for comparing or researching several topics on https://sitemcp.dev/. Pass one short page-title/topic query per item. Discovers real URLs from the site's sitemap and reads matching pages concurrently in one call. Returns ready-to-use Markdown citations and page text including live product v

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List page URLs on https://sitemcp.dev/ (from its sitemap, or links on the homepage).

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch a page from https://sitemcp.dev/ live and return its main content as Markdown. Include the returned Source link in the final answer for this product/page. Returns with when it was read and when the page says it last changed. Long pages are paginated with offset.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Discover published URLs across the sitemap and search https://sitemcp.dev/ for pages relevant to a query. For multiple topics use research_pages instead. Returns matching pages with snippets, each with when it was read and when the page says it last changed.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Orientation for https://sitemcp.dev/: title, description, language, sitemaps, robots.txt, pages discovered and search-index status. Optional; not required before research.

tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Metadata for one page on https://sitemcp.dev/ without its full text: title, description, headings, canonical URL, published and modified dates, content type, language and word count. Use it to decide whether a page is worth reading.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: Every link on one page of https://sitemcp.dev/, with its text and whether it stays on the site. Use it to navigate the site instead of guessing URLs.
